revision: K: connected pod hardware and captured travel stop
status: Candidate design; strength screens and nominal CAD, not fabrication release

stop.note: M5x14 DIN 7991 screw + 8/5.3 x 6 mm steel sleeve + washer + DIN 439 thin nut. Linked screw source documents the 16 mm variant/head; 14 mm length is a procurement requirement. Sleeve OD/length have no selected SKU or tolerances. Nut needs a validated locking method. Slot endpoints compensate nominal radial clearance.

tray.note: 4 mm 6061-T6 tray and two drilled 10 mm long aluminum bearing blocks replace the J printed structural cradle. Strip screen does not establish plate torsion, local bracket stiffness or fatigue.

joints.note: Bolts/nuts shown as dimensioned envelopes. Exact grades, locking, torque, fit, spring-pin retention and supplied angle radii remain to be finalized.

mass.note: K complete pod boundary includes fixed cheeks/cap and local rail clips; excludes motor, wheel and hub. Existing bottom-frame and unfinished F carrier allowances are retained, not removed as savings.
